ov: Land-living crustaceans with flat, segmented bodies and seven pairs of legs. They breathe through gill-like or lung-like pleopods and need damp places, under logs and stones. Some roll into a ball for defence. They are neither lice nor insects.

why.p: Woodlice are popular terrarium pets because of their varied colours and textures and how easy they are to care for.

rg: All kinds of habitats worldwide except the polar regions and very high altitudes.
df: Dead plant matter, especially partly decayed leaves; they also eat their own droppings for extra nutrients.
fx: Females carry their eggs in a brood pouch under the body, so the young appear to be born.
One desert species lives in “the driest habitat conquered by any species of crustacean”.
